traces.answer:
Who said that AI means everything in SaaS needs to be a personalized experience?
Anneka Gupta
AI will also have a personalization layer on top of it so we can talk to it like ChatGPT or Claude where I don't know every single feature in Asana so if I say "I want to track my time better" it would understand what I mean and make some suggestions to help me do that versus just saying "Hey here's how you use the timer."
What does that look like in practice? Well, there is this concept called "intents." So, when you're using the app, you'll tell it what your intent is, and then the system will go through different pieces of code that try to fulfill those intents. That way, you won't need to navigate through multiple places. It'll just take care of it for you. The second piece is more around understanding who your users are, which we've talked a lot about, right? How do you really get to know them, how do you really personalize for them? Because right now, you're talking to a persona, not a real human being. There are so many personas in a company. There are 500 people. You might think that one team uses Slack, another team uses Microsoft Teams, and they all use something else. But actually, everyone uses Slack because they don't even know anything else. They just use whatever tool is available to them. So, making sure that our products deeply understand who our customers are and why they buy us, why they choose us over others, is super important.
